definition.v1_behavior: Six annual rows; all four Revenue/EBITDA/PAT/EPS components required. The canonical input bridge certifies fiscal continuity and positive endpoints. V1 classification aggregates four growth rates.

definition.mandatory_change: Remove EBITDA from mandatory core; retain Revenue, PAT and EPS, each with six comparable consecutive full-year observations spanning five fiscal intervals.
definition.optional_change: Source-qualified reported EBITDA and separately governed operating earnings become optional enrichment.
definition.entity_change: Require exact NON_FINANCIAL classification for standard branch; bank/NBFC/insurer branch policy and unknown classification block interpretation.
definition.output_change: One result exposes three core CAGR components, completeness and optional coverage; no four-to-three score conversion or automatic ACCELERATING/HEALTHY carry-forward.
definition.reason: EBITDA is not a universal standardized reported line; exact wording is narrower than ambiguous Revenue, Profitability and EPS Trend.
definition.risk: Three rates cannot inherit V1 four-component aggregates or calibrated state cutoffs; PAT/EPS attribution and restatements must remain comparable.

definition.proposed_name: Entity-Aware Return Efficiency — ROE and Qualified ROCE
definition.v1_behavior: Joint PAT/EBIT/equity/debt/cash intake; latest PAT divided by mean beginning/end equity; EBIT divided by capital employed. Legacy ending-only denominator fallback is explicitly labelled.
definition.purpose: Describe return efficiency using a standard non-financial ROE core and separately qualified ROCE; require native financial-sector contracts.
definition.mandatory_change: ROE is the proposed non-financial core. Require exact beginning/end total equity matched to annual PAT; V2 removes ending-only fallback for average-equity ROE.
definition.optional_change: Qualified ROCE and formula-matched official ROE/ROCE corroboration; absence does not erase ROE evidence.
definition.entity_change: BANK native ROE/ROA may be future branch candidates; NBFC/INSURER remain policy blocked. Industrial ROCE is not the bank/insurer return concept.
definition.output_change: READY_STANDARD_BRANCH only for complete standard core; READY_ENTITY_SPECIFIC_BRANCH only after separate native branch approval; PARTIAL, POLICY_BLOCKED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA and conflict states remain explicit.
definition.reason: ROE and ROCE definitions, equity attribution and capital-employed denominators are not automatically uniform.
definition.risk: Removing joint requirements and ending fallback changes eligibility; source PAT/equity scope must agree. No V1 joint healthy classification may be reused.

components.measurement_definition: Annual PAT / ((beginning total equity + ending total equity) / 2); exact matching basis, positive mean equity, no parent-only/group-total mix.
components.period_contract: FULL_YEAR, exact fiscal identity, same statement scope and accounting basis; no TTM substitution. Two consecutive annual equity boundaries; latest annual PAT.

required_inputs: approved EBIT or separately named numerator contract
components.period_contract: FULL_YEAR, exact fiscal identity, same statement scope and accounting basis; no TTM substitution. Two aligned balance boundaries; no ending fallback.

definition.formula_note: This proposal does not approve a new ROCE numerator or capital-employed formula. Negative PAT is descriptive if denominator valid; no universal healthy threshold.

definition.proposed_name: Entity-Aware Leverage — Debt/Equity, Net Debt and Qualified Interest Coverage
definition.v1_behavior: All debt/equity/cash/EBIT/interest inputs required jointly; any absent input blocks the entire leverage evaluation; coverage drives STRESSED before D/E drives ELEVATED.
definition.purpose: Expose leverage, net-debt position and independently qualified coverage without concealing missing coverage or creating a healthy verdict.
definition.mandatory_change: Debt/equity is the proposed ordinary non-financial core; absence prevents full core readiness but does not delete other ready component evidence.
definition.optional_change: Net debt and qualified interest coverage are OPTIONAL_COMPONENT; observed adverse coverage is retained prominently, with risk escalation dependent on separate approved policy.
definition.entity_change: Banks, NBFCs and insurers require native capital, leverage/solvency contracts; unknown classification remains policy blocked.
definition.output_change: Core completeness and full component coverage are distinct. Optional absence cannot become HEALTHY; no new BLOCKING_COMPONENT threshold is introduced.
definition.reason: Debt/equity, net debt and interest coverage answer independent questions; DSCR includes debt service and cannot replace interest coverage.
definition.risk: Partial leverage evidence must not suppress red flags or be interpreted as V1 healthy; financial debt semantics differ.

definition.purpose: Describe current quarterly revenue, after-tax profit and per-share earnings comparisons with complete-core and optional-earnings coverage separated.

definition.reason: Quarterly reporting purpose is retained without universal EBITDA requirement or one-component completeness claims.
definition.risk: Stricter full-core readiness differs from V1 wrapper eligibility; reported growth is not organic acceleration.

definition.proposed_name: Profitability Margin Trajectory — Net Profit Core, Qualified Margin Context
definition.v1_behavior: Name promises operating and gross margins; actual evaluator measures latest quarterly EBITDA/revenue and YoY change with five-quarter intake. No canonical gross-margin numerator.
definition.purpose: Describe explicitly named after-tax profitability margins while separating operating, gross and issuer-defined EBITDA contexts.
definition.mandatory_change: Propose NET_PROFIT_MARGIN as named non-financial core from exact reported PAT and revenue; this is a new proposed scope requiring human governance, not an already approved formula.
definition.optional_change: PBT, direct operating, gross and issuer EBITDA margins are distinctly named optional components with independent contracts.
definition.entity_change: No industrial PAT/revenue, operating or gross-margin mechanics for BANK/NBFC/INSURER without native policy; unknown remains blocked.
definition.output_change: Descriptive net margin levels and YoY percentage-point change; no V1 EXPANDING/CONTRACTING threshold transfer or inference about gross/operating margins.
definition.reason: Profitability is broader than operating/gross profitability. The explicit net-profit core makes the semantic loss visible rather than relabelling a substitute.
definition.risk: Net profit includes finance, tax and non-operating effects; cannot establish operational efficiency. Thresholds and source PAT attribution need governance/calibration before activation.

components.period_contract: Five consecutive QUARTER_ONLY fiscal observations q-4..q; exact YoY q/q-4 and QoQ q/q-1; no YTD substitution.

definition.v1_behavior: P/E drives classification; forward P/E, PEG, EV/EBITDA and P/B are optional calculations in the legacy evaluator. Canonical bridge blocks unsupported forward/share inputs and prevents legacy EV missing-debt/cash zero defaults.
definition.purpose: Preserve independently comparable valuation evidence with explicit component applicability and no automatic cross-component scoring.
definition.mandatory_change: No universal mandatory multiple; AT_LEAST_ONE_READY_APPLICABLE_COMPONENT establishes descriptive availability, not a full valuation verdict.
definition.optional_change: P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, forward P/E and PEG are independently optional; omitted inputs never default to zero.
definition.entity_change: Financial-sector P/E/P/B require native basis/comparison policy; industrial EV/EBITDA marked not applicable only by an approved classified entity exclusion.
definition.output_change: Each component uses READY/PARTIAL/NOT_READY/NOT_APPLICABLE/POLICY_BLOCKED presentation aliases; exact underlying insufficiency/conflict remains retained.
definition.reason: Absent EV/EBITDA must not erase valid P/E/PB evidence; fair-value and score conclusions require separate versioned interpretation.
definition.risk: An available multiple is not ATTRACTIVE. No score weighting, forecast or missing-debt/cash fill is authorized.

aggregation.scoring: No mapping from readiness to PASS/HEALTHY/ATTRACTIVE or numerical score; score eligibility false for an unapproved V2 interpretation adapter.
